rationale: The grant_type query declaration duplicates the OAuth token body property; the body's const grant_type governs the token contract (and lifts to the operation's constant body).

test.name: grant_type
test.description: The grant type for the token request.

provenance.observed: The OpenAPI operation declares grant_type in both the query parameter list and the JSON request body (where it is a const).
provenance.specd: The OAuth token request carries grant_type in its JSON body as a constant, with the duplicate query declaration omitted.
